name: Bond Street Barber Shop
brandNarrative:
Established in 2003, BSBS as the locals know it, quickly became the place where locals go for haircuts.

We have assembled an award winning group of barbers. Our mens haircuts have been voted "The Best" by The Source readers poll 17 years in a row.

Our talented barbers listen to you and give you exactly the haircut you want. From trendy Euro haircuts to military haircuts and everything in between BSBS is the place to go. We have provided haircuts for infants as young as 7 months old to our oldest customer, a mere 98 years old.

We are a business that enjoys giving back to our community. We have raised in excess of 100,000 dollars for our community. We love Bend and Bend loves us. Please come in and say hello.  The best haircuts, hot shaves, fades and ethnic haircuts in Bend.

We offer a complimentary Boneyard RPM or other seasonal Boneyard Beer on tap.

reviews.text: Brad has been cutting my hair for over a year and every time it’s been amazing. I have never had a barber give so much attention to detail on my cut as him. Every time it looks even better and this last cut was the best I’ve had in years. The shop itself is also super cool and they offer you a beer with your cut as well. There are no appointments so you have to put your name on a list, but for anyone complaining about wait times - most traditional barbershops I’ve been in around the country operate this way. The haircut you’ll get here is worth it.
reviews.author: Cameron H

reviews.text:
Where do you go in Bend when you want a fresh cut… good vibes… and free beers on tap while you’re at it?

Bond Street Barber Shop. Every time.

These guys are legit artists with the clippers. I walked out feeling sharp and relaxed—and the free beer definitely didn’t hurt!

Awesome barbers, cool atmosphere, and the kind of place you actually look forward to visiting.

Five stars, no question
reviews.author: Anthony Sayles

reviews.text: Friendly, free beer, tv's, clean. Great staff. Brad is awesome. Meticulous, really takes his craft seriously. Been living in Bend for 3 years now and after trying a few shops I only go there now.
reviews.author: John Erving

reviews.text: So this is my second time at this barber shop. I didn’t know where to go for my son’s hair ended up going here since they had walk ins. Let me tell you…. This the barber shop y’all need. For my son’s hair Seth fixed up the hair emergency he had. Then I got my brother who is visiting a cut by Gustavo. AMAZING service AMAZING atmosphere, Friendly & kid friendly. This is going to be your regular spot for a barber shop. This place is awesome. Thank you guys.
reviews.author: Mckailah Sane

reviews.text: Absolutely Amazing Amanda P. Is Probably, Potentially the Very Best Barber You'll Have ever really all the honor and pleasure to get friggin amazin' top'o'de'line service from!
